title: Top Symbol on a Bridge Tape
statement: Let $c$ be a partial recursive program, let $x$ be a finite input string over the bridge alphabet, and let $q$ be an optional control state of its bridging machine. For any valid input-head position $p$, stack assignment $st$, output string, and compiled-machine stack name $k$, the symbol read by the corresponding work-tape head is the top symbol of $st(k)$ embedded in the bridge alphabet, or blank if $st(k)$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A finite input string over the bridge alphabet
replaced:
In a bridge configuration with stack assignment $st$, the symbol read on the work
tape assigned to a stack name $k$ is the embedded top of $st(k)$, or blank when
$st(k)$ is empty.
